div.div:
scripts/local-stack.sh · the sequence compose cannot express
up → wait for three healthy brokers and the registry → create topics from topics.tsv with explicit partition counts → register subjects from subjects.tsv → on strict-security only: render ACLs, apply them, then verify least privilege before declaring success
down keeps volumes, destroy deletes them, status reports the profile and the registered subject count

div.div:
dev
scripts/local-stack.sh up dev
PLAINTEXT on every listener, no authentication, no authorizer
22 topics, 19 subjects
A convenience for iteration. It is never evidence of production security, and the script says so on the way up.

div.div:
strict-security
scripts/local-stack.sh up strict-security
SASL_SSL with SASL/PLAIN on the client, inter-broker and controller listeners, against a generated local CA
StandardAuthorizer with allow.everyone.if.no.acl.found=false
13 ACLs rendered from the committed per-service policies
Least privilege asserted in both directions before the banner prints
Certificates and credentials are generated into gitignored paths by scripts/generate-dev-security-material.sh
